notes.title: Announcement Regarding Game Abnormalities After the Update
notes.notes: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience we have caused. Previously, in the Steam version of the game, there were issues where missing audio files led to errors(This issue only affects users who are using the original Steam version of the game), so we pushed a minor update today. However, we have discovered that for users who have installed the complete version, updating through Steam overwrites the existing "normal game content," reverting the game back to the Steam version. We deeply regret this issue. If you have already updated the game, you can fix it by re-overwriting with the complete version game files. Please note that this Steam update will not affect your save data, so there's no need to worry. In the future, we will be more cautious with related updates to avoid such inconvenience (no further updates are planned).

notes.title: Important Notice to Our English Version Players
notes.notes:
Due to an oversight, the Scan page content in the English version of our game was mistakenly in Japanese. We are pleased to inform you that this issue has been rectified as of 10 minutes prior to the posting of this announcement. If you have encountered this issue, please refer to our homepage for guidance.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding and continued support.
